changelog: Room Host Transfer: Easily pass Watch Party control to any friend with `/host`.
Secret Private Effects: Discover hidden visual reactions that keep chat surprises exciting.
Ultra-Smooth Animations: Enjoy faster, lag-free visual celebrations during big moments.

features.title: What's New
items: Host Transfer Control: Hand over Watch Party leadership seamlessly using the new `/host <username>` command.
Secret & Private Effects: Trigger hidden reactions in chat that keep the full surprise secret from other viewers until they appear on screen.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Smarter Command Suggestions: Typing `/host` now instantly suggests members in your room for quick host transfers.

features.title: Performance & Stability
items: Ultra-Smooth Visual Reactions: Rebuilt animation engine for smoother particle celebrations and lighter memory usage.
